defect.description: The setting is read as settings['FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE'] or False instead of settings.getbool(...): command-line overrides arrive as text, so -s FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE=False (or =0) gives the non-empty string 'False', which is truthy and turns active mode on.

review_items: from_settings uses settings[...] or False without bool coercion; command-line 'true' stays a string; use getbool
`or False` is redundant/smell patching missing conversion
store() leaks FTP connection without with/try-finally on exceptions
Design: from_settings bypasses Settings.getbool coercion (information expert/coupling)
Test only passes True directly; add test for command-line string path
votes.evidence_quote: from_settings reads settings["FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE"] or False but never coerces the value to bool. ... Should use settings.getbool("FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE", False) instead.
votes.justification: The review points at the right line, the missing getbool coercion, and command-line string values. But it says the only harm is that self.active becomes the string "true". It even claims `or False` recovers the right value for "0". So it misses that "False" or "0" from the command line is truthy and wrongly turns active mode on.
